primary_source_method: Unauthenticated read-only urllib GET to official vercel/next.js repository security-advisories API; registry.npmjs.org metadata; official GitHub HTML for ambiguous ranges. Values below transcribed from actual responses, not an exploit test.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: Same use cache function called directly and via unstable_cache, reads root param; concurrent cold-process first-fill race.
reported_advisories.reason: Root locale param exists, but no use cache or unstable_cache usage; Cache Components default false.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: Cache Components enabled; nested use cache; inner root-param read and pending promises publish dependency metadata late.
reported_advisories.reason: No nested use cache; Cache Components not enabled. next/root-params alone is insufficient.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: cacheComponents true; partialPrefetching false/unset; self-hosted next start; generated dynamic param with ungenerated value; at least two never-prerenderable params below it; layout inside Suspense; blocking fallback shell.
reported_advisories.reason: Cache Components false; route inventory has locale plus one catch-all, not required two deeper params. generateStaticParams on locale alone does not establish vulnerability.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: App Router use cache functions receive binary arguments such as Uint8Array or Blob.
reported_advisories.reason: No use cache functions/binary argument cache path.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: Self-hosted App Router route handlers/fetch cache return fetched upstream Response unchanged; HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy permits pipelined response queueing; crafted upstream framing.
reported_advisories.reason: No app route handlers, fetch calls, or upstream response forwarding in current src. Production proxy topology unverified but missing code path excludes this application pattern.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: Self-hosted /_next/image optimizer can process attacker-supplied SVG despite default dangerouslyAllowSVG false.
reported_advisories.reason: Confirmed installed affected version and enabled default optimizer used across site. Self-hosted start script present, but actual deployed adapter/optimizer exposure and attacker-controlled SVG source not verified. No remotePatterns/upload/fetch handler in inspected app. Do not label exploitable or call default SVG rejection mitigation.

reported_advisories.prerequisites: App route handler or Pages Edge API route sets sensitive HttpOnly cookies through NextResponse; internal x-middleware-set-cookie header leaks publicly.
reported_advisories.reason: No Edge runtime declarations, route/API handlers, NextResponse or cookie-setting path in current src.

extended_target_sanity_check.scope_note: Sanity check for a later advisory defeating patch recommendation, not a full historical security audit or clean bill. Several old vendor records contain literal unresolved patch tokens; do not repair them.

ambiguous_records.prerequisites: Root-level catch-all page plus SSG/ISR routes.
ambiguous_records.reason: Current catch-all is nested under locale and locale uses generateStaticParams. Short vendor description does not prove whether this root-level prerequisite encompasses this topology. No exact fixed tag can be established from literal 16.3.?; neither 16.4.5 nor 16.4.6 certified clear for this advisory.
Vendor explicitly next dev MCP endpoint only, not production. next dev script exists; exact patched release unknown from vendor token.
Requires Pages Router SSG/ISR; project has App Router only.
Requires webpack metadata image routes; no opengraph-image/twitter-image dynamic route exists.
Vendor explicitly excludes apps without images.remotePatterns; no such configuration here.

already_fixed_example.reason: Do not misattribute older SVG RCE to installed 16.4.3 or conflate with new SVG rejection bypass.

release_and_compatibility.16.4.6_note: Backports: create-next-app Tailwind pin, route-handler response compression, Turbopack development GC; no additional security fix stated. Not selected merely for latest status; ambiguous advisories remain unresolved by its notes.

local_observation.negative_search: src recursively: use cache|unstable_cache|cacheLife|cacheTag|rootParams|fetch\(|NextResponse|runtime\s*=|use server|next/image|cookies\(|headers\( returned only 25 next/image import matches; next-intl/dist use cache|unstable_cache returned zero.
